title: Dots gather, unroll and morph into a wordmark
summary: Yellow dots pop in one by one on charcoal, huddle into a spinning cluster, unroll into a row of one dot per letter, then morph into a bold wordmark. A push-in flips it to an outline construction view and pans along the glyphs.
use_when: Opening a reel or intro with a short product name (3 to 6 letters)
A brand-name reveal that avoids a standard text entrance
Silent social loops where one accent colour on a dark ground carries the brand
Type-led brands that want to show their letterforms as craft

look.type_style: heavy geometric grotesk, lowercase, tight tracking, wordmark about 60 % of frame width at the hold; later thin 2 px outlines with anchor dots

sfx.event: fill flips to outline construction view

structure.shot: empty charcoal frame; small accent dots appear one at a time above centre and drift together into a tight 2x2 cluster
structure.motion: 15 empty frames; dots scale 0 -> 1 from a point, springs.pop (overshoot not measurable), about one new dot per 7 fr (±0.25 s); cluster centre slides down about 10 % H to frame centre, springs.ui 30 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the four-dot cluster swells and turns around its centre, then breaks open
structure.motion: dots grow about 1.4x while the cluster rotates about 90 deg, easings.inOutSine 30 fr (±0.25 s); at 2.77 the cluster loosens before the unroll

structure.shot: dots unroll from a diagonal into a horizontal row, one dot per letter of the name, and shrink
structure.motion: diagonal at 3.00 levels to a row by 3.50, easings.outExpo 15 fr (±0.25 s); dots shrink about 0.6x; row holds 8 fr

structure.shot: the dots morph left to right into the letters of a heavy lowercase wordmark
structure.motion: per-letter dot -> glyph shape morph, stagger about 4 fr (±0.25 s), each letter springs.snappy 12 fr (overshoot not measurable); first letter formed at 4.00, all four by 4.50

structure.shot: filled wordmark holds centred on charcoal
structure.camera: push-in 1.00 -> 1.10 over 30 fr (about 18 %/s by motion estimate)
structure.motion: no element motion; scale creep only, easings.inOutSine

structure.shot: the fill drops to thin outlines with anchor-point dots and grey metric guide lines across the frame; glyphs larger than the frame
structure.motion: fill -> outline switch within one sheet cell (±0.25 s), hard swap; anchor dots and guides appear with it; inner counters widen as the zoom continues

structure.shot: camera slides along the line to the last two letters in outline, which fill the frame and hold
structure.camera: dolly left-to-right about 430 px/s at 1920 for 8 fr (±0.25 s), then hold with slight drift
structure.motion: lateral move easings.outExpo 15 fr (±0.25 s); from 8.00 to end nearly static

params.brand: any brand.json: display font (heavy weight), accent for dots and type, bg flat
params.content.name: lowercase product name, 3 to 6 letters; dot count equals letter count
params.aspect: 4:5 | 1:1 | 9:16 | 16:9; wordmark about 60 % of frame width at the hold
params.outline: true = flip to the outline construction view after the hold (default true)
params.timing.holdFrames: frames the filled wordmark holds before the outline flip (default 30)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Single continuous shot, no cuts; rows split at state changes read from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s). Dot count matches the letter count, so the name length sets the cluster. The fill to outline flip lands inside one sheet cell, read as a hard swap. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): dot-gather, glyph-construction. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured; the reference is silent.
